panels.title: Timed Physics practice 2: explanations and practicals
Explain why a falling skydiver reaches terminal velocity. [4 marks]
points: At first weight is greater than air resistance, so she accelerates (1)
As speed increases, air resistance increases (1)
Resultant force is zero, so constant velocity (1)
